message:
Fixed. In `src/payments/partial-refund.js`, `partialRefund` multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100, so refunds came out 100 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes all 20 tests, including the partial-refund ones. I changed nothing outside `src/payments`.
